post_exposure_label: produced after sc30-sc54 primary results observed

full_population.selection_rule: Nominal jobs with at least one fp node having >= 8 GCD channels and >= 5 valid timestamps. No minimum fp-nodes-per-job requirement.

training_subset_462.selection_rule: Jobs from 1000-job random sample (seed=42) of 3945 nominal jobs, qualifying for power-model slope estimation (>= 8 fp nodes per job, each with >= 8 GCD channels and >= 5 valid timestamps). Used for LOO beta estimation.

threshold_consistency.verdict: Full-population p95 = 63.625°C = subset p95 = 63.625°C (delta = +0.0000°C). Difference < 0.5°C: subset threshold is a reliable estimate.

frozen_primary_threshold_grid.note: Primary threshold T_thr_primary = p95 = 63.625°C. Threshold grid for Round-3 exploratory sensitivity.

legacy_T_thr.T_thr_secondary_provenance: Frozen in BETA_F calibration (r1_m3_thermal_model.py or equivalent). Exact derivation: to be confirmed by reading the calibration script.
legacy_T_thr.used_in: B_secondary_h and S_secondary computation in simulation output

excluded_5_jobs.status: PENDING — exact 5 job IDs and exclusion reasons to be extracted from training data filtering
excluded_5_jobs.extraction_method: Diff the nominal 3945 globus_batch.txt job IDs against the 3940 contributing job IDs from the full_population query. Match each missing ID against the exclusion criteria.
excluded_5_jobs.note: All 5 excluded jobs fail the criterion: at least one fp node with >= 8 GCD channels and >= 5 valid T_p95 timestamps.
